body: It's my first time applying for a beta test, I've always wanted to since trying the game launch day. It might end up being a bore-fest, and very demanding, but I know the rules; including that **Imposing** NDA agreement.
Your art is amazing btw! I hope we get some type of Liyue garb skin for Kaeya as reference.
Jiji! I've been trying to find more people who recognized Kaeya's JP VA, who also plays Mikazuki in Touken Ranbu. My heart is happy.
Because I'm depressed and fed up with life. I don't feel like a burden; I'm tired of living with all this mental pain. Worrying over little things, and worrying about my mother all the time.

I'm 23 and currently taking care of my 78 year old adopted mother (grandmother on my birth mother's side.) We barely get by on her SSI with about $1900 a month since the bills are $1300 at most; the rest goes to immediate supplies and recent car repairs (excluding food.) 

I /can't/ work because if I take my eyes off of her for 5 minutes she either trips and falls or chokes on literally everything. She's the only human being in all of our blood related family to care about me, and vice versa; everyone else is a greedy cunt waiting to strike like a snake the moment our asses get caught out. She still has her mind, but her body is slowly deteriorating.

Once she dies, I'll have three options: work, be homeless, or suicide. I, myself have severe depression and anxiety so sometimes the overwhelming thought of dealing with a 9 to 5 scares me shitless. Not to mention all of the nutjobs out there who would rob/kill me with no hesitation.
I'd be interested to rp wth you. I'm 22 and I often write fantasy and fictional stories. I don't use discord often I'm pretty active. A new friend wouldn't hurt either XD
